title: When Bias Backfires: The Modulatory Role of Counterfactual Explanations on the Adoption of Algorithmic Bias in XAI-Supported Human Decision-Making
reasoning: The paper focuses on a behavioral experiment regarding human interaction with biased AI and the effects of counterfactual explanations on decision-making. While it addresses 'fairness' and 'equitable decision-making' as goals of XAI, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/ethical systems.
